fonts.display: 'ModernEra', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'ModernEra', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Warm Parchment
palette.role: Gray accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis.

palette.name: Candlelight
palette.role: Lighter cream for elevated surfaces and secondary text on dark — a half-step above Parchment for subtle layering

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Structural borders, section dividers, image edge treatments — used as a hairline, never as a fill

palette.name: Walnut Shell
palette.role: Dark canvas behind full-bleed photographs, footer backgrounds, and dark editorial sections — the deep brown that makes white type glow warm

palette.name: Aged Bronze
palette.role: Secondary dark surface and border on dark sections — a half-step lighter than Walnut for subtle layering on dark

palette.name: Amber Glow
palette.role: Navigation borders, active state accents, warning/attention states, and the single chromatic punctuation in an otherwise warm-neutral system

palette.name: Muted Gold
palette.role: Link borders and heading underlines on dark sections — a desaturated brass for typographic detail without breaking the monochrome feel
